issues.description: The problem statement (and the template's example usage in Main.java) specify Milkable.messageOnMilk() with no parameters returning a String like "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". The solution repository, however, defines Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) (adds a double parameter) and implements it accordingly in Goat and Seal. This parameter mismatch means the solution's interface and implementations are incompatible with the specification and with the template Main example that calls messageOnMilk() without arguments, preventing students from following the described API and using the provided Main example.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the Milkable API with the problem statement and template Main usage by removing the volume parameter: change the interface to String messageOnMilk() and update Seal and Goat implementations to implement messageOnMilk() returning "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". Alternatively, if the volume parameter is intentional, update the problem statement and template Main example to call messageOnMilk(double) and describe the expected message format including volume.

issues.description: The problem statement and template expect a Milkable.messageOnMilk() method with no parameters returning a simple string ("[Animal Type] [name] is milked"). The solution repository defines Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) (i.e., adds a double parameter) and updates Goat and Seal implementations to match. This changes the method signature across artifacts, breaking the direct mapping from the exercise description/template (which call messageOnMilk() with no args) to the solution implementation and would cause compile-time or usage errors and extra cognitive load for students.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature across all artifacts. Change the solution to implement Milkable.messageOnMilk() with no parameters (String messageOnMilk()) and update Goat and Seal to return "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". Alternatively, if a volume parameter is desired, update the problem statement and template Main.java to call messageOnMilk(double) and document the parameter in the exercise description.
